title: Best Leather Loafers 2026: 5 loafers tested over 6 months
description: G.H.Bass Weejuns, Alden Handsewn, Tod's Gommino, Thursday Loafer, and Cole Haan Pinch Grand — 6 months of business and casual wear. Construction, leather aging, comfort.
lede: Five loafers. 6 months of wear. We compared Goodyear-welt vs. cemented, leather aging, and which loafers transitioned from suit to casual.
methodology: Each pair worn 2-3 days per week for 6 months. Tracked sole wear, leather creasing, comfort breakdown, and visual aging.

sections.heading: Construction tiers
paragraphs: Goodyear-welt (Thursday, Alden): resoleable, 10+ year lifespan with care.
Driving (Tod's Gommino): rubber pebbles on sole, casual-only.
Cemented (Cole Haan): not resoleable, 5-7 year lifespan.

sections.heading: Best for each use
paragraphs: Best American luxury: Alden Tassel Loafer ($695-895).
Best comfort: Cole Haan Pinch Grand ($190-250).

faqs.a: Casual: no socks (no-show socks for hygiene). Business casual: dress socks (don't go bare). With suits: matching socks.

faqs.q: Are penny loafers still in style?
faqs.a: Yes — they're a classic that cycles in/out of trends but never disappears. G.H.Bass Weejuns are the original from 1936.

faqs.q: Can I wear loafers with a suit?
faqs.a: Penny loafers (G.H.Bass): casual suit ok. Tassel loafers (Alden): more formal, better with suit. Driving loafers (Tod's): casual only.
Alden runs narrow naturally. Thursday and G.H.Bass run average. Tod's runs slightly wide.

gh-bass-weejuns-penny-loafer.review: G.H.Bass Weejuns is the original penny loafer (1936). Leather upper, signature penny slot, American classic. The benchmark.

alden-tassel-loafer-leisure-handsewn.review: Alden Tassel Loafer is the American luxury loafer. Hand-sewn in Massachusetts, Goodyear-welted, top-quality calf leather. 'Made in USA' premium pick.

tods-gommino-driver.review: Tod's Gommino Driver is the driving loafer benchmark. Suede or leather, signature rubber pebbles on sole, made in Italy. Casual-only.

thursday-mens-loafer.review: Thursday Loafer is the right DTC value loafer. Full-grain leather, leather sole, Goodyear-welt at DTC pricing. Resoleable.

cole-haan-pinch-grand-loafer.review: Cole Haan Pinch Grand Loafer is the comfort-focused American loafer. Leather upper with Grand.OS comfort technology, classic silhouette. Comfortable for all-day wear.

offerNotes.alden-tassel-loafer-leisure-handsewn: Available at aldenshop.com and authorized retailers.
